timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Thank you all for giving up a busy spring afternoon to be with us here to dedicate St. Sebastian Church.
I also want to thank you for your continuing support of the entire Brian Park development project.
Thanks to the vision of fine planners and architects like Jack and Leslie Rollins.
A tragically neglected part of San Francisco will soon become a show place community of churches, schools and apartment homes.
So let us, with Father Hanley, dedicate this cross this symbol of new life for Brian Park.
Let us pray. Holy Lord, Almighty Father, have a lasting God.
People used to bless this cross that it may be a saving help to mankind, that it be the support of faith and encouragement to good works,
the redemption of souls, that it be in consolation, a protection, a shield against the darts of the enemy through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Amen. Let us pray. Lord Jesus Christ, bless this cross by which you snatched the world from Satan's grasp and on which you overcame by your suffering, the tempted of sin,
who rejoiced and the first man's fall in eating of the forbidden fruit.
May this cross be hallowed in the name of the Father, the Son, the Holy Spirit, may all who kneel and pray before it in the name of our Father,
find help in body and spirit through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
Amen.
